assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless-style 2D cutout foliage texture for layered 3D game tree canopy cards. Input images: Image 1 is a foliage color/style reference only; Image 2 is a terrain-top color reference, not relevant to foliage shape. Primary request: a single dense leafy branch cluster, no trunk. Subject: dozens of small rounded oval broad leaves, each roughly 1.5 times longer than wide, softly rounded with a subtly pointed tip; dense center and naturally extending outer leaves, a few small transparent gaps. Style/medium: refined hand-painted game texture with subtle pixel-like painted color blocks, matching the lush stylized foliage colors of Image 1. Composition/framing: isolated centered cluster filling most of the square canvas, fully contained with margin; no leaf cut off at edges. Lighting/mood: flat orthographic material view, no cast shadows, no environment, no directional lighting. Color palette: light yellow-green leaf tips, grass-green middle layers, deep green lower/shaded leaves. Constraints: true transparent background and preserved alpha; designed as an opaque-leaf PNG cutout for 3D tree canopy cards. Avoid: spherical or ball-shaped mass, whole tree, trunk, branches prominent, diamond-shaped leaves, chaotic triangles, sharp spiky foliage, background, ground, shadow, text, watermark.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tiling BaseColor texture for the top surface of a stylized game terrain module. Input images: Image 1 is a foliage reference, ignore its shapes; Image 2 is the reference for the yellow-green grassy top color only. Primary request: a square, perfectly seamless tileable top-down grassland color texture. Subject: low-contrast natural grassy color patches, fine hand-painted pixel-like paint blocks and subtle mottling, predominantly grass green and light yellow green with restrained olive variation, matching the grassy top of Image 2. Style/medium: refined stylized hand-painted game texture, flat albedo/BaseColor map. Composition/framing: texture only, evenly distributed detail that continues seamlessly across all four edges, no focal center. Lighting/mood: no perspective, no directional illumination, no shadows, no highlights, no baked lighting; neutral flat color data. Constraints: opaque image, tile seamlessly horizontally and vertically, suitable as a terrain top BaseColor. Avoid: individual drawn grass blades or line strokes, rocks, objects, flowers, soil/cliff, horizon, perspective, lighting gradients, shadows, text, watermark.
